posts.text: Promoter and related persons taken big reduction in remuneration from goodluck india. But are they compensating it by alloting goodluck defense shares at cheap prices to known persons/ some kind of back of the hand deal? This is just skeptical speculation from my side. Further inputs from members would be greatly appreciated. Especially those who have contact with the management.

posts.community: Goodluck India Ltd - Will it bring Good Luck for us?
posts.text: Results were good. What concerned me was how the management responsed then investores grilled on the “Goodluck defence.” Their standard response was that their advisors had recommended the same approach . I am sure the management understood what they were doing and the potential impact it could have on minority shareholders. I’m not sure, however, whether the grilling will actually make them reconsider or reverse their current course. There was also good amount of promoter selling stake (close to 2.44%) in June 2026, which makes me wonder whether they already understood the potential impact. i…
